TAPS is not a primary label or synonym in the cited ontology capture. The supplier expansion reaches the exact ontology primary systematic name and matching structure. The term CAS xref supports correspondence but is not an explicit unique CAS-to-ontology lookup.

TAPS sodium salt owner is cas:91000-53-2 with sodium-containing formula and separate primary identity. pH8.3 does not prove sodium-salt procurement. No alias restoration, salt conflation or full sodium-salt approval is justified.

Manufacturer assays and catalogue identities are evidence for names/structures, not DSMZ purchase or measured grade. The source17.4g remains in its recipe scope, helper occurrence1 is not recipe frequency, and no role/components or inferred source formulation should be added.
